approach: Reference design for Data-Driven 2D Adventure Game: implement each milestone independently, test expected and failure cases, and document configuration and assumptions. This is an architectural solution guide, not a fully runnable code submission.
review_checklist: Verify required features against the 100-point rubric.
Run tests in a clean environment matching the declared Lua/runtime version.
Review security, persistence, external service/resource failure paths as applicable.
Reproduce setup and validate all examples.

implementation_steps: Implement and verify: input and rendering.
Implement and verify: tests and packaging.
reference_outline.quality_gate: Review tests, resource cleanup, error handling, version assumptions, and accessibility/usability where applicable.
